Round 3: fixed D7 (Medium) from refuter's review of Round 2, which confirmed D1-D6 all genuinely fixed. estimated_effort_hours is a Postgres int4 column (db.Integer) with max 2,147,483,647; _parse_optional_number(as_int=True) validated finite/non-negative but had no ceiling, so a value above int4's range parsed successfully and only failed at db.session.commit() with psycopg2.errors.NumericValueOutOfRange (a DataError, not an InterfaceRegisterError) -- uncaught by comparison_routes.py's `except InterfaceRegisterError`, producing an unhandled 500 instead of a clean validation flash. Fixed by adding a MAX_INT4 = 2_147_483_647 constant and ceiling check inside _parse_optional_number's as_int branch, raising InterfaceRegisterError with the ceiling value when exceeded (grepped for an existing hours-validation convention first -- none found, so used the column's own storage ceiling). Added max="2147483647" to the estimated_effort_hours input in comparison.html as a client-side hint. Added test_attach_work_package_rejects_effort_hours_above_int4_ceiling to tests/test_work_package_service.py, posting estimated_effort_hours=3000000000 and asserting a clean InterfaceRegisterError (the exact regression test that would have caught D7).
